snippet.title: EXD - Extra Dimensional | PCVR Game | Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Hi everyone! It has been a long time and now you know why. We have been secretly working over the past years on our new PCVR game EXD - Extra Dimensional. Here is the reveal trailer, fully shot in-game.
Like what you see? Wishlist EXD on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3962020?utm_source=youtube_marco
We are still working on it, but it will be out soon!
Cheers,
Marco
